design_overview: UniStudy is a modern, student-focused platform designed with clarity and ease of use in mind. The interface prioritizes quick access to study notes, seamless group collaboration, and intuitive navigation. The design follows iOS/Android native patterns with card-based layouts, clear visual hierarchy, and touch-optimized interactions. The color scheme uses academic blues and greens to convey trust and learning, while maintaining high contrast for readability.

typography.font_family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen showing overview of recent activity, quick actions, and personalized content

key_components.name: Top Header
key_components.styling: White background with subtle shadow, displays 'Welcome back, [Name]' in bold text, includes notification bell icon on right
key_components.interaction: Static header, bell icon navigates to Notifications screen

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: Light gray background, rounded corners (12px), search icon on left, placeholder text 'Search notes, groups, subjects...'
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens search screen with filters

key_components.name: Quick Stats Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded corners, displays 3 columns: Notes Uploaded (number), Groups Joined (number), Downloads (number), each with small icon above
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, informational display

key_components.name: Recent Notes Section
key_components.styling: Section header 'Recent Notes' in bold, followed by scrollable horizontal card list, each card shows note title, subject tag, rating stars, and download count
key_components.interaction: Each card navigates to Note Detail screen

key_components.name: My Groups Section
key_components.styling: Section header 'My Study Groups' with 'View All' link, vertical list of group cards showing group name, subject, member count, and last activity
key_components.interaction: Each card navigates to Group Detail screen, 'View All' navigates to Groups screen

key_components.name: Upload Notes Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button with white text, rounded corners, plus icon on left, text 'Upload Notes', fixed at bottom above nav bar
key_components.interaction: Opens upload modal or navigates to upload screen

key_components.name: Subject Subscriptions
key_components.styling: White card with 'Subscribed Subjects' header, horizontal scrollable chips showing subject names with checkmark icons
key_components.interaction: Tapping chip navigates to subject-filtered notes view

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White background with 5 icons: home (filled), search, groups, bell, user, with labels below each
key_components.interaction: Each icon navigates to respective screen, current screen icon is filled/highlighted

screens.user_flow: Entry point after login → Can navigate to Notes, Groups, Notifications, Profile via bottom nav → Can search or upload notes → Can tap cards to view details

screens.name: Notes Browse
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of all available study notes with filtering and search capabilities

key_components.name: Screen Header
key_components.styling: White background, 'Study Notes' title in bold, filter icon on right
key_components.interaction: Filter icon opens filter modal

key_components.name: Search Input
key_components.styling: Light gray rounded input with search icon, placeholder 'Search by title, subject, or keyword'
key_components.interaction: Real-time search filtering as user types

key_components.name: Active Filters
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable chips showing active filters (subject, rating, date), each with X to remove
key_components.interaction: Tapping X removes filter, updates results

key_components.name: Sort Dropdown
key_components.styling: Light gray button with text 'Sort by: Most Recent' and down arrow icon
key_components.interaction: Opens sort options: Most Recent, Highest Rated, Most Downloaded

key_components.name: Notes List
key_components.styling: Vertical scrollable list of note cards, each card shows: thumbnail icon, title, subject tag, uploader name, rating (stars), download count, file size
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Note Detail screen

key_components.name: Note Card
key_components.styling: White card with subtle shadow, rounded corners, left side has document icon/thumbnail, right side has title (bold), subject tag (colored chip), rating stars, download icon with count
key_components.interaction: Tap to view note details

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with text 'No notes found' and 'Try adjusting your filters' below
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, shown when no results

key_components.name: Load More Button
key_components.styling: Secondary outlined button with text 'Load More Notes'
key_components.interaction: Loads next page of results

key_components.name: Floating Action Button
key_components.styling: Circular primary blue button with plus icon, positioned bottom-right above nav bar
key_components.interaction: Opens upload notes screen

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Home or bottom nav → User can search, filter, sort → Tap note card to view details → Can upload new notes via FAB → Return to Home via bottom nav

screens.name: Note Detail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a single study note with download, rating, and review capabilities

key_components.name: Top Navigation
key_components.styling: White background with back arrow on left, share icon on right, note title in center
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to previous screen, share icon opens share options

key_components.name: Note Preview Card
key_components.styling: Large white card with document preview thumbnail/icon, file name, file type badge (PDF/DOCX), file size
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive preview

key_components.name: Note Info Section
key_components.styling: White card with note title (large bold), subject tag (colored chip), description text, uploaded by (user name with small avatar), upload date
key_components.interaction: Tapping uploader name navigates to user profile

key_components.name: Stats Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal row showing 3 metrics: Average Rating (stars + number), Downloads (icon + count), Reviews (icon + count)
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display

key_components.name: Download Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button, full width, white text 'Download Note', download icon on left
key_components.interaction: Downloads file, increments download count, may show success toast

key_components.name: Rating Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'Rate this note' header, 5 interactive star icons, optional text input for review
key_components.interaction: Tapping stars sets rating, typing adds review, submit button saves rating

key_components.name: Reviews List
key_components.styling: Section header 'Reviews', vertical list of review cards showing user avatar, name, rating stars, review text, date
key_components.interaction: Scrollable list, non-interactive cards

key_components.name: Related Notes
key_components.styling: Section header 'Related Notes', horizontal scrollable cards showing similar notes from same subject
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to that note's detail screen

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Notes Browse or Home → User views details → Can download note → Can rate and review → Can view related notes → Back button returns to previous screen

screens.name: Study Groups

key_components.name: Screen Header
key_components.styling: White background, 'Study Groups' title in bold, filter icon on right
key_components.interaction: Filter icon opens subject filter modal

key_components.name: Tab Navigation
key_components.styling: Two tabs: 'My Groups' and 'Discover', active tab has blue underline and bold text
key_components.interaction: Tapping switches between user's groups and all available groups

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: Light gray rounded input with search icon, placeholder 'Search groups by name or subject'
key_components.interaction: Filters groups as user types

key_components.name: Create Group Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button with plus icon and text 'Create New Group'
key_components.interaction: Opens create group modal/screen

key_components.name: Groups List
key_components.styling: Vertical scrollable list of group cards, each showing: group name (bold), subject tag, description preview, member count, admin badge if applicable, last activity timestamp
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Group Detail screen

key_components.name: Group Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded corners, group name at top, subject tag (colored chip), member avatars (up to 3 shown), member count text, 'Join' or 'View' button on right
key_components.interaction: Tap card to view details, tap button to join or view group

key_components.styling: Small green dot with 'Active' text on group cards with recent activity

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with text 'No groups yet' and 'Create or join a group to get started' with action button
key_components.interaction: Action button opens create group screen

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White background with 5 icons, 'Groups' icon is highlighted/filled
key_components.interaction: Navigate between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed from bottom nav → User can switch between My Groups and Discover tabs → Can search and filter → Tap group to view details → Can create new group → Join groups from Discover tab

screens.name: Group Detail
screens.purpose: View group information, members, and participate in group discussions

key_components.name: Top Navigation
key_components.styling: White background with back arrow on left, group settings icon on right (visible only to admin), group name in center
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to Groups screen, settings icon opens group management

key_components.name: Group Info Card
key_components.styling: White card with group name (large bold), subject tag, description, created by info with avatar, member count, max members indicator
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive info display

key_components.name: Join/Leave Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button 'Join Group' or secondary outlined 'Leave Group' depending on membership status
key_components.interaction: Joins or leaves group, updates member count, shows confirmation

key_components.name: Tab Navigation
key_components.styling: Three tabs: 'Discussion', 'Members', 'Resources', active tab has blue underline
key_components.interaction: Switches between group content sections

key_components.name: Discussion Messages
key_components.styling: Scrollable message list, each message shows user avatar, name, timestamp, message text, messages from current user aligned right with blue background
key_components.interaction: Scrollable, non-interactive messages

key_components.name: Message Input
key_components.styling: White input bar with rounded corners, placeholder 'Type a message...', send button (blue) on right
key_components.interaction: User types message, tapping send posts to group, clears input

key_components.name: Members List
key_components.styling: Vertical list of member cards showing avatar, name, admin badge if applicable, joined date
key_components.interaction: Scrollable list, tapping member may show profile (future feature)

key_components.name: Resources Section
key_components.styling: List of shared notes within group, similar to notes browse cards
key_components.interaction: Tapping note navigates to Note Detail screen

key_components.name: Share Note Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button 'Share Note to Group' visible in Resources tab
key_components.interaction: Opens note selector to share existing note with group

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Groups screen → User views group info → Can join/leave group → Can switch between Discussion, Members, Resources tabs → Can post messages → Can view members → Can access shared notes → Back button returns to Groups

key_components.styling: White background, 'Notifications' title in bold, 'Mark all read' text button on right

key_components.name: Filter Tabs
key_components.styling: Three tabs: 'All', 'Notes', 'Groups', active tab has blue underline and bold text
key_components.interaction: Filters notifications by type

key_components.name: Notifications List
key_components.styling: Vertical scrollable list of notification cards, unread notifications have light blue background, read notifications have white background

key_components.name: Notification Card
key_components.styling: Card with icon on left (note icon for new notes, group icon for group activity), notification title (bold), message text, timestamp, blue dot indicator for unread
key_components.interaction: Tap to view related content and mark as read

key_components.name: New Note Notification

key_components.name: Empty State

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices. Layouts use flexible containers that adapt to screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. Touch targets minimum 44px for accessibility. Cards and lists use full-width on mobile with 16px horizontal padding. Horizontal scrolling used for secondary content to preserve vertical space. Bottom navigation fixed for easy thumb access.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant with minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for text. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Icons paired with text labels. Form inputs include clear labels and placeholders. Error states use color plus text/icons. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Keyboard navigation supported for web version.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability: button press shows 0.95 scale with 150ms ease-out, card tap shows subtle elevation increase, page transitions use 300ms slide animation, loading states show skeleton screens, pull-to-refresh uses native patterns, success actions show brief checkmark animation, tab switches use horizontal slide, modal appears with fade-in and slight scale from 0.95 to 1.0
icons: Consistent icon set using outline style for inactive states and filled style for active states. Icons include: home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash, share. All icons 24px size in navigation, 20px in cards, 16px in tags. Icons always paired with labels for clarity except in bottom navigation where labels appear below icons.
